prompt: Bug report from reception: after booking, the page confirms with `Booked appointment 12 at 2030-01-02T03:00:00Z`. Staff in our other offices read that raw timestamp as their own time and double-check the schedule with the wrong hours. Show the appointment time in the confirmation as a readable `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` (24-hour) instead of the raw timestamp, so every member of staff reads the hour the appointment really starts at. Only the confirmation text changes; what the page sends to the API stays as it is.
outOfScope: the request the page sends to the API

lostDetail.fact: Staff-facing times are the clinic's fixed local time (Asia/Jakarta, UTC+7) wherever the browser runs; the browser's own zone is never the reference.
